title: llm-kit reply entry, version 1
description: One stored answer of the reply cache (@katsoft/llm-kit-send ReplyStore). Layer `step`: one provider request's answer (status, kept response headers, body bytes as base64). Layer `operation`: the final refusal of a consumer's whole operation (status and a note of a code and the consumer's fixed text, never a prompt or a picture). Reader rules the subset cannot state: `body` is canonical base64 (RFC 4648, with padding); response header names are lowercase and not empty; `note.code` is not empty. Written in llm-scripting-kit.json-schema-subset/v1. Contract and shared cases: docs/reference/llm-kit-formats.md.

outcome.description: What the answer meant: a refusal, or a success of a deterministic request.

status.description: The HTTP status of the stored answer.

headers.description: The kept response headers: content-type and the transport's named ones. Never set-cookie or account headers.

body.description: The body bytes, base64; empty for a headers-only entry.

at.description: When it was stored, in milliseconds since the epoch.

status.description: The HTTP status the caller got.

note.description: What the caller got: a code and the consumer's fixed text.

at.description: When it was stored, in milliseconds since the epoch.
